title: Kannitini Chusi Datiponi Deva – Paul Alexander Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: యాకోబు బావి కాడ ఎవరూ లేని సమయములో
english: Yaakobu baavi kaada evaroo leni samayamulo
Naa paina endaro raallu ruvvuvAru nna
translation: O God, who does not pass by seeing my tears,
You stood right before me in the moments when I was crushed and broken.
Won’t You come and touch me with Your holy hand?
I am eagerly waiting for You in my prayer.
Son of David, have mercy on me!
Countless times I have lost my way and gone astray.
Though I strayed, You called me back with Your Word,
And You turned my mourning and tears into dancing!
By Jacob’s well, at a time when no one else was around,
In that exact moment when I came just seeking water to drink,
You became the spring of living water in my life,
And transformed my dry, barren existence into a flowing stream.
Though so many were ready to hurl stones at me,
You hid and protected me within Your loving grace.
If You hadn’t intervened and come for me,
What would have become of my life today!
intro: Kannitini Chusi Datiponi Deva is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned, sung & produced by Paul Alexander and music composed by Suresh Punuru. This song was released on April 24, 2026, through LYRICS OF THE SPIRIT YouTube Channel.
